description: agent-action under v43 exercising nostr:publish(kind=00). kind is an integer key and 00 is the integer 0, so the exercised scope does not meet nostr:publish(kind!=0): verifier MUST reject with E_SCOPE_DENIED.

expected.spec_reference: §7.2 rule 4 (integer keys) and §7.4 (!= compares integer keys as integers)
expected.rejection_reason: 00 and 0 are the same integer. A verifier that compares the bytes reads 00 as a different value and admits it under kind!=0, while a relay or client reads kind 0.
